# What CI does not run, and why. cmd/aura/tier_runners_test.go fails on a tracked test file
# behind a feature build tag that no CI `go test` executes (tags, package and -run all
# reaching it) unless an entry here excuses it, and on any entry that is stale or has no
# reason. Python drivers are not followed, so the files they alone run are listed.
#
# [tags]         <tag> | <reason>            every unreached file behind the tag runs by hand
# [files]        <path> | <reason>           one tagged test file no CI invocation reaches
# [routes]       <tag> | <via> | <reason>    the text credits the tag, control flow never gets there
# [conditional]  <tag> | <reason>            a step that may not run on a push still counts for it

[tags]
agent_eval        | paid: every case is a real turn against a real model on the live deployment (make agent-eval)
cot_eval          | paid: the scheduler North-Star smoke drives DeepSeek-V4 over OpenRouter, operator-authorized
live_e2e          | paid or outward-facing: real-model runner, reasoning and Ollama-cloud rounds, and a real Telegram delivery to a named chat
live_finalize     | paid: forced finalization against the real DeepSeek-V4/OpenRouter endpoint, operator-authorized
measure           | measurement harness: prints numbers and asserts nothing, so it gates nothing
turn_recall_eval  | paid: the frozen turn-recall eval asks the configured teacher model once per uncertain turn
retrieval_eval    | measurement harness over the real corpus; the scored release eval runs only in the full scope of scripts/ingest_reconcile_e2e.sh, which needs a real LLM key
document_live_e2e | real-agent document E2E: runs only in the full scope of scripts/ingest_reconcile_e2e.sh and in scripts/ingest_media_e2e.sh, both needing a real LLM key
backup_live       | unwired — owner decision pending (2026-11-25)
pim_contract_live | unwired — owner decision pending (2026-11-25)
pim_mail_e2e      | unwired — owner decision pending (2026-11-25)
serve_smoke       | unwired — owner decision pending (2026-11-25)
smoke             | unwired — owner decision pending (2026-11-25)
